title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 02, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.0 (Peaked November 02, 2026 at 22:08 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 405 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Space is throwing a little extra energy around today! 🛰🔌🌎

A broad dark coronal region and several bright active regions are visible in today’s solar images, while the coronagraph appears routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304/211/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
